title: C++ - Advanced weird overloads[->/*]
description:
Now, it's time for your classes to start cosplaying as a pointer. As in, you are now going to overload `->` and `*`.
```cpp
T& operator*();
T* operator->();
```

---
## Assignment:
Make the `*` and `->` overloads for the Handle class: They should return pointers and references to the inner T.
